// Boss Invasion (EventMode 17) -- PARKED 2026-09-20.
//
// These 156 rows are complete and correct. They are commented out only because
// the client patch carrying the HUD indicator went live before the server side
// was deployed: Sungame.exe reads this table directly, so it announced
// "Boss Invasion" on schedule while the VPS was still running a FieldServer
// with no _JB_BOSS_INVASION in it, and nothing spawned.
//
// To switch back on: delete the leading "//" from each row below, ship this
// file, and deploy a FieldServer built with _JB_BOSS_INVASION at the same time.
// The two halves must go together -- the HUD reads the schedule locally and
// will claim an invasion whether or not the server can honour it.
//
